build_transformer_block: build a Transformer module with multi-head self-attention and feed-forward layers for neural architecture search
create_channel_se_layer: create a ChannelSELayer squeeze-and-excitation block to apply channel-wise attention to feature maps
build_ops_registry: build a neural op lookup using the OPS dict to instantiate conv, sep_conv, dil_conv, or msa layers
create_separable_conv: create a SepConv module with two depthwise separable convolutions and batch norm for NAS cells
parse_op_kernel_size: parse an op string like 'conv_3x3' with parse_op_ks to extract the operation name and kernel size
